games.name: MunchMiner
games.description: Dig into a side-view world, build a rail network, and turn the materials you bring home into toys for the evening market.
games.alt: MunchMiner's town, with a warmly lit workshop and its black-ball inhabitants
steps: Explore a side-view mine, excavate materials and shape your own route underground.
Lay track and build powered facilities. Station Dudu carts carry materials through your rail network.
Bring materials home, learn toy recipes and prepare your workshop's stock.
Attract customers, sell the toys they want and prepare for your next expedition.

games.name: Circuit Stance
games.description: Take the role of a super AI. Combine modular chips to program your robots, test your tactics in the arena, and refine your next strategy.
games.alt: Circuit Stance arena screenshot from the official Steam gallery
steps: Combine modular chip actions to create different robot behaviours.
Try your tactical builds in the arena and see how your decisions play out.
Experiment with new combinations and improve your strategy between matches.
